name: bizplug-sports-teams
description: The sports teams & venues plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: seat availability and ticket requests. It works from the business's own published profile, covering schedules, tickets, venue and merchandise, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
